notes: Field-sampled: the surface itself carries no undercut at this parting.
Judged with the ring as built: 5 CAD parts (2 joined, 3 cut) at the parting plane z = +0.00 mm — 465.9 mm² of part surface, 0.1 mm² of it undercut.

Extrude "Raise the plinth into the crown" (#7): 0.1 mm² of undercut leaning to -90° on flanks facing back across the parting plane, 72–108°, 1.5 mm toward the low edge to 1.5 mm toward the high edge — stage it Bench to solder it on after the pour (the pattern keeps a locating mark), or move it onto the parting line.
With its CAD parts 22.0% of the ring carries less than 3.0 deg of draft or stands parallel to the pull — it releases, but drags on the sand.

summary: 6 x 2.6 band carrying a vertical wheel 12.0 mm across and 3 thick, square to the finger and standing 11.5 mm off the crown on a splayed plinth; 8 lancets on 0.85 mm spokes round a hub, 8 quatrefoils, a rim moulding, pierced through.
